links.text: Unfinished Business 26 - 29 August Would you rewrite a past decision that could change your future? From Company Three. Book Tickets
AMPLIFY 11 & 12 September A bold new devised work from the alumni of Kestrel Theatre Company. Book Tickets

The First Year (of the Gaza Genocide in the Media) 22 September - 10 October 2026 A blistering multimedia investigation into the relationship between mainstream media, public opinion, and state crime from BÉZNĂ Theatre. Book Tickets
STUFFED 13 - 24 October 2026 A blazing inferno of physicality, electronica, and uncompromising personal testimony from the frontlines of the UK's food banks from Ugly Bucket. Book Tickets

Orlando: A Pornobiography 10 November - 12 December 2026 Across erotic entanglements, historical ruptures, and queer intrusions, an ensemble of transfemme performers tear through Virginia Woolf’s Orlando in this brazen anti-adaptation from piss / CARNATION. Book Tickets
Operation Mincemeat West End, Broadway & Touring Operation Mincemeat, the multi-award-winning musical by Spitlip, was commissioned and premiered at New Diorama Theatre in 2019. Further Info
